User.title: User
User.description: Represents an authenticated user in the EstateHub system, assigned a specific role for access control.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

email.description: The unique email address of the user, used for authentication and identification.

role.description: The assigned role of the user (e.g., Admin, Apartment, Contractor, Security), determining their access and permissions.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores general profile information for a user, independent of their specific role-based entity.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

userId.description: Reference to the associated User. (Relationship: User 1:1 UserProfile)

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

phoneNumber.description: The contact phone number of the user.

address.description: The physical address of the user.

profileImageUrl.description: URL to the user's profile image.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

Apartment.title: Apartment
Apartment.description: Represents a physical apartment unit within the estate, used for tracking residents and related services.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Apartment entity.

unitNumber.description: The unique unit number of the apartment.

building.description: The building name or identifier where the apartment is located.

squareFootage.description: The total square footage area of the apartment unit.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the apartment record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the apartment record was last updated.

Resident.title: Resident
Resident.description: Represents a person residing in an apartment, linked to an 'Apartment' role user and an 'Apartment' unit.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Resident entity.

userId.description: Reference to the associated User with an 'Apartment' role. (Relationship: User 1:1 Resident)

apartmentId.description: Reference to the Apartment unit the resident lives in. (Relationship: Apartment 1:N Resident)

firstName.description: The first name of the resident.

lastName.description: The last name of the resident.

phoneNumber.description: The primary contact phone number for the resident.

emergencyContactName.description: Name of the emergency contact person for the resident.

emergencyContactNumber.description: Phone number of the emergency contact person for the resident.

startDate.description: The date when the resident started living in the apartment.

endDate.description: The date when the resident moved out of the apartment, if applicable.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the resident record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the resident record was last updated.

ServiceVendor.title: ServiceVendor
ServiceVendor.description: Represents an external service provider, such as a contractor or utility provider, linked to a 'Contractor' role user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ServiceVendor entity.

userId.description: Reference to the associated User with a 'Contractor' role. (Relationship: User 1:1 ServiceVendor)

name.description: The name of the company or individual service vendor.

contactPerson.description: The primary contact person for the vendor.

phoneNumber.description: The contact phone number of the vendor.

email.description: The contact email address of the vendor.

type.description: The type of service provided by the vendor (e.g., 'Contractor', 'UtilityProvider').

specialtyOrService.description: A description of the vendor's specialty or specific service offered.

qrCodeData.description: Encoded data for the QR code generated for the vendor, if applicable (e.g., for Contractors).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the service vendor record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the service vendor record was last updated.

SecurityPersonnel.title: SecurityPersonnel
SecurityPersonnel.description: Represents a security guard employed at the estate, linked to a 'Security' role user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SecurityPersonnel entity.

userId.description: Reference to the associated User with a 'Security' role. (Relationship: User 1:1 SecurityPersonnel)

firstName.description: The first name of the security personnel.

lastName.description: The last name of the security personnel.

employeeId.description: The unique employee ID assigned to the security personnel.

contactNumber.description: The contact phone number of the security personnel.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the security personnel record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the security personnel record was last updated.

Rate.title: Rate
Rate.description: Defines various pricing rates for services or passes within the estate, managed by administrators.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Rate entity.

name.description: A descriptive name for the rate (e.g., '1-day Apartment Pass Rate').

rateType.description: The type of rate calculation (e.g., 'fixed' amount or 'per_sqft').

baseRate.description: The fixed monetary amount for the rate, if rateType is 'fixed'.

ratePerUnit.description: The monetary amount per unit (e.g., per square foot), if rateType is 'per_sqft'.

unit.description: The unit of measurement if ratePerUnit is used (e.g., 'sqft').

durationInDays.description: The duration in days this rate applies for (e.g., 1, 7, 30 for passes).

appliesTo.description: Specifies what this rate applies to (e.g., 'ApartmentPass').

validFrom.description: The start date and time from which this rate is valid.

validTo.description: The end date and time until which this rate is valid. Null if indefinite.

adminId.description: Reference to the Admin User who created or last updated this rate. (Relationship: User 1:N Rate)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the rate record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the rate record was last updated.

Bill.title: Bill
Bill.description: Represents a financial obligation or invoice issued to a user or entity for services or fees.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Bill entity.

sourceEntityId.description: The ID of the entity from which the bill originates (e.g., Apartment.id, ServiceVendor.id). This could be the source of the fee or service.

sourceEntityType.description: The type of the source entity (e.g., 'Apartment', 'ServiceVendor', 'SecurityPersonnel' for their payroll).

payerUserId.description: Reference to the User who is responsible for paying this bill. (Relationship: User 1:N Bill)

payeeUserId.description: Reference to the User who is entitled to receive payment for this bill. (Relationship: User 1:N Bill)

amount.description: The total monetary amount of the bill.

issueDate.description: The date and time when the bill was issued.

dueDate.description: The date and time by which the bill is due for payment.

status.description: The current status of the bill (e.g., 'issued', 'paid', 'overdue', 'cancelled').

description.description: A brief description or purpose of the bill.

relatedRateId.description: Reference to a Rate entity if this bill is generated based on a specific rate. (Relationship: Rate 1:N Bill)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the bill record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the bill record was last updated.

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: Records a specific payment transaction made to settle a bill or other financial obligation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Payment entity.

billId.description: Reference to the Bill this payment is settling. (Relationship: Bill 1:N Payment)

payerUserId.description: Reference to the User who initiated this payment. (Relationship: User 1:N Payment)

payeeUserId.description: Reference to the User who received this payment. (Relationship: User 1:N Payment)

amountPaid.description: The monetary amount paid in this transaction.

paymentDate.description: The date and time when the payment was processed.

paymentMethod.description: The method used for the payment (e.g., 'Credit Card', 'Bank Transfer', 'Cash').

transactionIdExternal.description: An ID provided by an external payment gateway or system for this transaction.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the payment record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the payment record was last updated.

SystemAuditLog.title: SystemAuditLog
SystemAuditLog.description: A secure log of critical system activities and transactions, often requiring Admin verification.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SystemAuditLog entry.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the action or transaction occurred.

actorUserId.description: Reference to the User who performed the action. (Relationship: User 1:N SystemAuditLog)

targetEntityId.description: The ID of the primary entity affected by this action (e.g., rateId, residentId, accessLogId).

targetEntityType.description: The type of the primary entity affected (e.g., 'Rate', 'Resident', 'AccessLog').

details.description: A detailed description of the action, potentially including a JSON string of changes.

method.description: The method through which the action was initiated (e.g., 'UI', 'API', 'QRScan').

verifiedByUserId.description: Reference to the Admin User who verified the method of this transaction. (Relationship: User 1:N SystemAuditLog)

verificationStatus.description: The status of the method verification (e.g., 'pending', 'verified', 'rejected').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the log entry was created.

Shift.title: Shift
Shift.description: Schedules a work shift for a specific security personnel.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Shift entity.

securityPersonnelId.description: Reference to the SecurityPersonnel assigned to this shift. (Relationship: SecurityPersonnel 1:N Shift)

shiftDate.description: The date of the scheduled shift.

startTime.description: The scheduled start time of the shift.

endTime.description: The scheduled end time of the shift.

status.description: The current status of the shift (e.g., 'scheduled', 'completed', 'cancelled').

adminId.description: Reference to the Admin User who created or managed this shift. (Relationship: User 1:N Shift)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the shift record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the shift record was last updated.

Attendance.title: Attendance
Attendance.description: Records the clock-in and clock-out events for security personnel, often linked to a shift.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Attendance entity.

securityPersonnelId.description: Reference to the SecurityPersonnel whose attendance is being recorded. (Relationship: SecurityPersonnel 1:N Attendance)

shiftId.description: Reference to the Shift this attendance event is associated with. (Relationship: Shift 1:N Attendance)

timestamp.description: The date and time of the attendance event (clock-in or clock-out).

eventType.description: The type of attendance event ('clock_in' or 'clock_out').

scannerUserId.description: Reference to the Security User who performed the scanning for this attendance event, if it was a relayed scan. (Relationship: User 1:N Attendance)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the attendance record was created.

AccessLog.title: AccessLog
AccessLog.description: Records the outcome of security pass evaluations based on scanned QR codes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AccessLog entry.

scannedAt.description: The date and time when the QR code was scanned.

scannerSecurityPersonnelId.description: Reference to the SecurityPersonnel who performed the scan. (Relationship: SecurityPersonnel 1:N AccessLog)

scannedEntityId.description: The ID of the entity whose QR code was scanned (e.g., Resident.id, ServiceVendor.id).

scannedEntityType.description: The type of entity whose QR code was scanned ('Resident' or 'ServiceVendor').

verdict.description: The result of the pass evaluation ('PASS' or 'FAIL').

reason.description: A brief explanation if the verdict is 'FAIL' (e.g., 'Expired Pass', 'Not Authorized').

relatedBillId.description: Reference to a Bill entity if access is directly tied to a payment or pass associated with a bill. (Relationship: Bill 1:N AccessLog)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the access log entry was created.

GlobalSettings.title: GlobalSettings
GlobalSettings.description: Stores global application settings, managed by an Admin.

firestore.reasoning:
The recommended Firestore data structure prioritizes Authorization Independence and QAPs (Queryable Access Patterns) through strategic denormalization and structural segregation, enabling simple, robust, and easily debuggable security rules. 

**Authorization Independence (Denormalization Strategy):**
1.  **User Profiles and Role-Specific Entities:** `UserProfile`, `Resident`, `ServiceVendor`, and `SecurityPersonnel` are treated as direct extensions of the `User` entity. They are nested under `/users/{userId}/` as single documents (e.g., `/users/{userId}/userProfile/profile`). Each of these documents directly includes the `userId` field (or the parent `userId` is implicit in the path), eliminating the need for `get()` calls to the parent `User` document for authorization checks. For instance, a `Resident` document includes its `userId` and `apartmentId`, making it self-sufficient for ownership and related apartment access.
2.  **Apartment Access:** To allow residents to access their associated `Apartment` details without a `get()` call, the `Apartment` document itself will be denormalized to include a map of `residentUserIds: {uid1: true, uid2: true}`. This allows a direct check `resource.data.residentUserIds[request.auth.uid]` in security rules.
3.  **Financial Transactions (`Bill`, `Payment`):** Both `Bill` and `Payment` documents explicitly store `payerUserId` and `payeeUserId`. This denormalization is crucial for enabling secure `list` operations (QAPs) where users can only view bills/payments they are directly involved in, without needing to `get()` related user or entity documents.
4.  **Admin-Managed Entities (`Rate`, `Shift`):** `Rate` documents include `adminId`, and `Shift` documents include both `securityPersonnelId` and `adminId`. This allows security rules to directly verify ownership or management rights.
5.  **Log Entries (`SystemAuditLog`, `Attendance`, `AccessLog`):** Each log entry includes relevant `userId`s (e.g., `actorUserId`, `verifiedByUserId`, `securityPersonnelId`, `scannerUserId`, `scannerSecurityPersonnelId`) directly within the document. This ensures that a user can list their own related logs, or an Admin/Security can list all, without needing to `get()` other documents.

**QAPs (Queryable Access Patterns) Support:**
*   **Path-Based Ownership:** The `/users/{userId}/...` structure naturally supports QAPs for user-specific data. A user can query their own `userProfile`, `residentProfile`, `serviceVendorProfile`, or `securityPersonnelProfile` by simply querying within their designated path.
*   **Role-Specific List Operations:** Collections like `/bills`, `/payments`, `/shifts`, `/attendance`, and `/accessLogs` are designed for efficient `list` operations for specific roles or users. For example, a security rule for `/shifts` can leverage `where('securityPersonnelId', '==', request.auth.uid)` because `securityPersonnelId` is denormalized within each `Shift` document.
